text: Any OpenAI SDK can be pointed at Morph's API by swapping base URL and key
quote: Point any OpenAI SDK at `https://api.morphllm.com/v1`. One API key covers the open-weight chat models and the specialized tools

text: Fast text classifiers (Reflexes) label conversation turns for jailbreaks, NSFW, loops, and frustration in ~90ms
quote: Small text classifiers that label a turn in ~90ms — jailbreaks, NSFW, stuck-in-a-loop, user frustration.

text: Production agents can be migrated from Anthropic/OpenAI to Kimi K3 via a gated traffic trial or full switch
quote: Move a production agent off Anthropic or OpenAI onto Kimi K3 — a 5% traffic trial or a full migration, gated by Reflexes.

text: A canary setup routes a slice of production traffic to a new model and compares results before switching
quote: A canary keeps your current provider, sends a slice of production traffic to Kimi K3, and compares Reflex results before you switch.

text: Morph offers an MCP server so tools like Claude Code can connect and use it
quote: Install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can read it

text: A small Reflex classifier can be trained in about 30 seconds
quote: A small Reflex trains in about 30 seconds.

text: Morph natively serves the Anthropic Messages API at /v1/messages for tools like Claude Code
quote: Claude Code speaks the Anthropic Messages API, which Morph serves natively at `/v1/messages`.

text: Existing Codex models can be given fast file-editing via morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s
quote: Keep your current Codex model and give it `edit_file` backed by `morph-v3-fast` at 10,500+ tok/s

text: High-throughput code editing claim of 10,500+ tokens/sec for Fast Apply merges
quote: Keep your current Codex model and give it `edit_file` backed by `morph-v3-fast` at 10,500+ tok/s

text: AI tools can connect to Morph's fast file-editing capability via Model Context Protocol
quote: Connect your favorite AI tools to Morph's blazing-fast file editing via Model Context Protocol.

text: Morph provides Warp-Grep for fast local code search alongside MCP setups
quote: Use Morph's Warp-Grep for fast, local code search alongside your MCP setup.

text: Fast Apply merges only changed lines at 10,500 tok/s with 98% accuracy
quote: Fast Apply merges just the changed lines at 10,500 tok/s, 98% accuracy.

text: Context compression drops filler from chat/code context at 33,000 tok/s with 50-70% size reduction, preserving surviving lines byte-for-byte
quote: Drop filler from chat history and code context at 33,000 tok/s. 50-70% reduction, every surviving line byte-for-byte identical to input.

text: Thousands of chat completions can be run offline in batch at half the real-time price
quote: Run thousands of chat completions offline at half price.

text: Prefix caching is enabled by default for every open-source model with no configuration or extra cost
quote: Prefix caching is on for every open source model. No configuration, no cache-write surcharge.

text: Users can reserve dedicated model capacity by selecting a model and plan, with Morph provisioning and operating it
quote: Reserve model capacity by choosing a model and plan. Morph provisions and operates it

text: The Anthropic Messages endpoint supports the same open-source models, token billing, and rate limits as the main API
quote: Anthropic Messages supports the same open source chat models, token billing, and rate limits.

text: Morph's API can intelligently modify existing code at 4,500+ tokens/sec
quote: Use Morph's API to intelligently modify existing code at 4,500+ tokens/sec
